_about: Recorded cues for tools/audio/cut_cc0.py (format from Crab Breeze, unchanged). A layer is {src: 'pack:file'} or {synth: '<gen_sfx layer or cue>'}, with optional shot (n-th shot of a multi-shot take), start, dur (s), pitch (tape-speed ratio), gain (dB after the layer is peak-normalised), lp, hp (Hz, steep), fadein, fadeout, delay (s), repeat. A cue may set len, drive (tanh), hp, lp (gentle, 12 dB/octave), distance (compressor, lowpass and reverb that push a bed into the background), loop, stereo, group, peak_db, what and edits. A cue whose what ends in (loops) loops in the game.

lance_fire.what: The Lance firing: a beam that snaps on, holds a detuned buzz and falls away.
lance_fire.edits: slowed to 0.7-0.8 speed, layered over our beam synthesis, lowpassed

disruptor_fire.what: A Disruptor bolt leaving its mount: a hard electric crack with a short tail.
disruptor_fire.edits: slowed to 0.85 speed, layered with a crack and our sub thump, saturated

torpedo_launch.what: A Pulse torpedo leaving its tube: a deep launch thump and a rising energy whine.
torpedo_launch.edits: a ship's cannon slowed and lowpassed to a thump, a phaser rise slowed to 0.6, our sub thump

overload_charge.what: A mount charging in overload (loops): an electric charge building and crackling.
overload_charge.edits: trimmed, lowpassed, crossfaded into a loop

missile_launch.what: A missile away: an ignition hiss and the motor roaring off.
missile_launch.edits: slowed to 0.9, layered with a rocket's roar, lowpassed

pd_burst.what: Point defence firing: a fast rattling burst.

shield_hit.what: A shot striking a shield facing: an energy thud with a glassy shimmer and a spark.
shield_hit.edits: two shield takes layered with our shimmer synthesis and a spark

hull_hit.what: A shot through to the hull: a heavy metal crunch and a short blast.
hull_hit.edits: a cannonball hitting a ship slowed to 0.8 and lowpassed, a metal slam at 0.6, saturated

torpedo_detonate.what: A torpedo detonating: a blast and the energy flaring out of it.
torpedo_detonate.edits: two blasts slowed to 0.7-0.8, layered with our energy bloom

explosion_small.what: A small blast: a missile shot down, a system blown out.

ship_destroyed.what: A ship destroyed: the blast, its core going up, the hull groaning apart and a long rumble.
ship_destroyed.edits: four takes slowed to 0.5-0.8 and layered over a low rumble, the metal lowpassed

engine_hum.what: A ship's engines under way (loops): a low, steady roar.
engine_hum.edits: a rocket motor slowed to 0.7 and lowpassed, a generator under it, crossfaded into a loop

thruster_burst.what: Manoeuvring thrusters: a short hiss of a turn or a stop.
thruster_burst.edits: a boost slowed to 0.6, a slice of rocket roar

reactor_hum.what: The reactor running (loops): a deep machine hum.

shields_raise.what: Shields coming up: a rising energy swell.

shields_collapse.what: A shield facing failing: the energy draining away with a last shield thud.

ui_clunk.what: A metal console key (the modelled skins): a switch with a heavy clunk under it.

amb_bridge.what: The bridge (loops): computers working, the air handling, the ship's hum, under everything.

layers.src: oga/sci-fi-ambience-sfx:SFX SCI FI Computer room ambience.mp3

amb_bridge.edits: three beds layered and panned, compressed, lowpassed and given a room, crossfaded into a loop
